purpose: Formally close the current reference-mode recovery substage once every required mode is either retained as an observed series or has a fully characterized blocker, exhausted admissible current-public-source paths, explicit non-reopen conditions and a declared evidence trigger for future reopening. Stage completion is not model completion and does not relax integrated-closure requirements.

blocker.required_boundary: sectoral financial stocks and financial transactions on the RMD sector/instrument boundary

findings: BNR 2024 CNF explicitly publishes a non-consolidated 2024 stock matrix by counterpart sector with S121 and AF2-AF8.
The same CNF report states that ESA 2010 series for 1995-2024 are available on the BNR website.

BNR Annual Report 2024 states that the Statistics Directorate periodically transmits quarterly financial-account series under the ECB strategy and annual financial accounts to Eurostat, and prepared the 2025 benchmark revision.
The screened BNR annual counterpart matrix does not supply the frozen quarterly stock plus financial-transaction history with at least 40 common quarters.

stage_completion_rule.rationale: Scientific completion of a recovery stage means the evidence boundary and reopen conditions are explicit and reproducible; it does not require manufacturing a missing observed series.

reopen_triggers: A changed ECB QSA dataset/source topology demonstrably adds the missing sector/instrument/transaction coverage after the retained 2026-09-19 audit.
A new official BNR machine-readable quarterly counterpart dataset supplies S121 and complete F2-F8 stocks and financial transactions on the frozen RMD boundary.
Eurostat counterpart dissemination expands to the complete F2-F8 quarterly stock/transaction instrument scope while preserving the required sectors including S121.
OECD counterpart dissemination adds Romania S121/central-bank sector detail while retaining complete F2-F8 quarterly stocks and financial transactions.
Another official source passes the frozen semantic-lineage contract and a separately preregistered historical-extraction contract.
non_reopen_conditions: Repeating unchanged ECB QSA, Eurostat or OECD probes.
Treating the BNR annual 2024 counterpart stock matrix as quarterly history.
Interpolating annual counterpart stocks to quarters.
Dropping BNR/S121 or any required instrument after observing source coverage.
Relaxing the minimum common-history requirement after observing available data.
Using synthetic residual allocation, missing-to-zero rules or reconciliation fit to choose mappings.
